from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
class Check(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.stack = []
        self.errors = []
        self.links = []
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag not in {'meta', 'path', 'circle', 'rect', 'br'}:
            self.stack.append(tag)
        if tag == 'a': self.links.append(dict(attrs).get('href'))
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag in {'path', 'circle', 'rect'}: return
        if not self.stack or self.stack.pop() "'!= tag: self.errors.append(tag)
page = Path('"'index.html').read_text()
p = Check()
p.feed(page)
assert not p.errors and not p.stack, (p.errors, p.stack)
assert 'tel:+15035550142' in p.links
assert all(date in page for date in ['2027-07-01', '2027-07-21', 'July 22, 2027', '503-555-0142'])
assert '<script' not in page and '<link' not in page
print('Verified: balanced HTML, closure and reopening dates, catering phone link, and no external dependencies.')
print(f'Created index.html ({len(page.encode()):,} bytes).')
PY"
